thresholds.reference: A (Relume React control) at the same route/viewport
thresholds.semantic: score = 100% of SAC-expected roles present at every viewport (role tree vs A is informational: the control has its own defects)
thresholds.responsive: column counts and padding-top of the nearest <section> (or data-fs-id section root) containing the route heading equal to A at every sweep width (the 64px series 375..1440 plus every DSC screens[]/breakpoints[] minWidth and minWidth-1 inside 375..1440) and no horizontal overflow
thresholds.animation: translateY within 2 percentage points of column height of A at every probe sample; sticky stage = viewport (height == innerHeight, top == 0); reduced motion gives identity transform
thresholds.tokenIntegrity: C only: boundShare over DSC-governed declarations = 100% and 0 DSC token mismatches/missing. D-6 accounting: zero lengths (0, 0px, 0rem, 0em, 0%, -0px, all-zero multi-values) are neutral; a literal is excluded when generated-manifest.json ungoverned[] covers it (strict: same file basename; loose: stylesheet not identifiable; viaShorthand: each non-zero component covered on its axis, padding-left/right <-> padding-inline, padding-top/bottom <-> padding-block, row/column-gap <-> gap, border-*-radius <-> border-radius, and the shorthands); raw share is informational
thresholds.visual: STRETCH: pixel mismatch <= 1% (pixelmatch threshold 0.1, includeAA false); SSIM and height difference reported
thresholds.accessibility: 0 serious or critical axe violations per route/viewport
thresholds.determinism: C only: the FROZEN*.md whose "DSC revision:" equals generated-manifest.json dsc.revision and the generate:verify* script whose --dsc file has that revision are selected and recorded (D-7); that script exits 0; every entry of the selected FROZEN file (paths relative to the arm-c root) found on disk with an equal SHA-256; (bundle reproducibility reported separately)
thresholds.licence: C only: 0 matching lines >= 40 chars against Arm A reference source excluding pure import/export-from lines (reported separately); 0 forbidden-string hits (supplementary, not proof)
thresholds.fonts: Source Sans 3 face loaded (document.fonts) on every page
